主要内容: On November 17, 2014, Actavis plc ("Actavis") and Allergan, Inc. ("Allergan") issued a joint press release announcing the execution of an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement") by and among Actavis, Allergan, and Avocado Acquisition Inc., a Delaware corporation and an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Actavis. The Merger Agreement is a significant development in the pharmaceutical industry, as it outlines the terms of a potential merger between two major players in the sector. The merger is expected to create a combined entity with a broader range of products and a stronger market position. The definitive joint proxy statement/prospectus will be delivered to shareholders of Actavis and Allergan, providing detailed information about the merger and its implications. Investors and security holders are urged to read the definitive joint proxy statement/prospectus and other documents that will be filed with the SEC. This Form 8-K filing from November 17, 2014, outlines the disclosure of information related to the merger between Actavis and Allergan. The document highlights that investors and security holders can access free copies of the registration statement and the definitive joint proxy statement/prospectus through the SEC's website. Actavis and Allergan have also provided access to their respective websites and investor relations departments for copies of the documents filed with the SEC. The filing notes that participants in the merger solicitation, including Actavis, Allergan, their directors, and certain executive officers, may be considered participants in the solicitation of proxies. The document also includes a cautionary statement regarding forward-looking statements, which are used to describe estimated or anticipated future results, including synergies, and reflect the company's current perspective as of the date of the communication.
